second_reading_on_same_page.note: The ticker block on the same page showed 4,025.71 with a daily change of -106.80 (-2.58%). Two readings on one page differ by 1.08 USD/oz, consistent with a live tick updating between page sections. The calculator therefore treats the spot price as a user-editable input and never as a fixed fact.

usage_policy: This is a single point-in-time record, not a live feed. It is displayed with its timestamp wherever it is used.
The calculator defaults to this value but every field is editable; the site never silently refreshes a price.

Gold value computed from this number is a MELT-VALUE ESTIMATE ONLY. It ignores fabrication, setting, diamond value, labour, duty and retailer margin, and it cannot be computed for any ring in this dataset because no listing published a gram weight (see flag F-04).

unit_constants.note: Exact by definition of the troy ounce; used for arithmetic only.
